source: Foodland Ontario / Ontario Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Agribusiness (Ontario Data Catalogue)
dataset: Foodland Ontario fruits and vegetables availability guide (dataset id d7b3123b-ccc7-4cd2-ac7b-82717cf6da18)
semantics: Binary per month: 1 = Ontario-grown product available / in season, 0 = not (per dataset data dictionary). Includes greenhouse rows, so some items are 12/12.
method: Downloaded the two English XLSX resources with curl (resource URLs from the CKAN package_show API), unzipped them and parsed xl/sharedStrings.xml and xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml with the Python stdlib (zipfile + xml.etree). Column A = name, columns B..M = Jan..Dec as 0/1. Names whitespace-normalized; name_en assigned by hand mapping using the shared cross-region convention (eggplant, zucchini, beetroot, sweetcorn, swede, spring onion, snow pea, sweet pepper). Field/greenhouse variants kept as separate items with a note.
name_en_convention: US/international names for the joinable key: eggplant, zucchini, beetroot, sweetcorn, swede, rocket, spring onion, snow pea, sweet pepper, chili pepper.
